# How to check a record after the cutover

Use this when a patron or staff member reports a title that looks wrong in Fernbank after the [[Project Kestrel|catalog migration]].

## Steps

1. Search the title in the staff view and count how many records come back. Two records for the same edition usually means a duplicate; see [[Duplicate records triage, 2026-03-24#What we found]].
2. Open each record and compare the item list. Our items carry the branch code at the start of the barcode.
3. Check for our local subject headings, such as "Tamarack Valley history". If they are missing, note the record number.
4. Do not merge or delete records yourself. Send the record numbers to [[Odile Varga]] with a short note.

## Barcodes that will not scan

If an item barcode fails, compare it with the rule in the [[Bookwright export field map#Barcodes]] before relabeling the item.
